description: Opinionated Gradle plugins for building Spring Boot applications and libraries with clean architecture, as the build-system companion to the Modular Spring Platform (MSP).
rules: com.stano.settings must be applied first, in settings.gradle.kts, before rootProject.name is set.

com.stano.base (or a plugin that extends it, like com.stano.application or com.stano.library) must be applied to the root project before any other com.stano.* plugin, or dependent plugins throw a GradleException at apply time.
The extension registered by com.stano.base is named `root`, not `base` -- configure it in the root build.gradle.kts as `root { javaVersion = "21"; mspVersion = "..."; contextName = "..." }`.

When both com.stano.java-library and com.stano.maven-central-publish are applied to the same project, only maven-central-publish's `mavenJava` publication is created automatically -- java-library's private-repo publication is skipped to avoid a duplicate-publication coordinate collision.

Never capture the `docker` extension instance inside a Task action (doFirst/doLast) in com.stano.docker -- it holds a live Project reference and is not configuration-cache-safe. Read resolved values into local variables first.
